source.note: This report describes the cited EDCM state plus the current repo-owned plan. Report-only and language-boundary documentation commits are coordination metadata; they do not upgrade measurement, empirical, proof, semantic, or canon status. The current UCNS lexical-floor premise is deprecated and replaced by a dictionary-corpus direction with Scrabble dictionary authorized as the source class.

portfolio_role.summary: Measure and pressure responses under declared constraints, maintain falsifiable measurement candidates and evidence states, and consume exact upstream gonol representations without treating representation as measurement validity or silently inserting token, subword, opaque-vector, or whole-string-hash layers.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: EDCM consumes exact source evidence, declared semantic constraints where used, and pinned UCNS structural candidates, profiles, or future dictionary-derived gonol receipts without inheriting their authority. The current lexical direction is Unicode character gonols -> dictionary words/entries -> word gonols -> dictionary definitions/senses -> definition gonols as first lexical recursion; UCNS owns that construction.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: EDCM emits measurement artifacts, experiment findings, receipts, and explicit evidence statuses that downstream systems may consume without upgrading them.

reports_to.relation: repo-owned measurement-plan and evidence-status input; no authority transfer

status.current_claim: EDCM supports represented, candidate-measured, and experiment-supported evidence in declared scopes; canon_selection remains null and empirical validation is not established. For language, EDCM is a downstream consumer of a gonol-native UCNS path. The NGSL lexical-floor premise and fixed-list semantic closure are DEPRECATED. A Scrabble dictionary is authorized upstream as the replacement lexical source class; dictionary definitions will establish source-bound semantic relations among word gonols as the first lexical deep-recursion layer. Historical token/profile and lexical-floor-named surfaces remain sealed evidence only.
